exposure: Gestational age at delivery (late term and post term)
cohort: 142 mothers with a diagnosis of oligohydramnios after 40(+6) weeks of gestation
finding: There were no significant differences in adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes between different modes of delivery for women with oligohydramnios in late-term and post-term pregnancies.
mod_finding: Adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes in late-term and post-term pregnancies with oligohydramnios may not be different among different modes of delivery.
gest_age: Late term and post term (≥40+6 weeks)
